facts.value_text: Samsung later reported that HBM3E 12-stack products were in mass production and generating sales in the third quarter of 2024.
facts.observed_at_text: October 31, 2024 Q3 earnings-call vintage reporting the third-quarter mass-production state

metadata.sales_context: The same source says the 12-stack product was generating sales.
metadata.onset_guard: The source proves that mass production had been realized by the Q3 reporting context but does not state when production began; canonical valid onset remains unknown.
metadata.timing_guard: Do not infer that mass production started in Q3 or that the earlier Q2 target was missed.
metadata.qualification_guard: Mass production and sales are not treated as proof of completed NVIDIA or other named-platform qualification.
